thread:
Maya: Quick sync — GateFlow + LangChain folks scheduled 10am PT tomorrow. Goal: finalize marketplace listing, joint announcement cadence, and HW compatibility callouts. Agenda: connector readiness, orchestrator adapter, perf benchmarks for A100/L40, co-marketing assets.
Raj: Can we confirm which model artifact variant we want to publish for the initial listing (fp16, int8)? Partner prefers int8 for cost numbers.
Erin: Orchestrator runner v0.9 supports streaming + function-calls. Adapter interface is stable; just need a README and example. I'll drop a sample config.
Sam: Partner asked for p50/p95 numbers with 512 context on A100 and L40. I can run quick jobs tonight and post.
Jordan: Marketing needs embargo window, logo kit, and a one-paragraph partner quote by EOD Monday. Also need to know if we can offer a short joint webinar in week of release.
Maya: Perfect. I've created a draft PR: `repos/partners/gateway-orch/announcement.md` — please add perf table, adapter usage snippet, and legal-approved quote.
Raj: I'll attach perf CSV + notes by 7pm PT. Quick decision point: recommend int8 as default artifact, but mention fp16 fallback in docs?
Erin: Recommend int8 for marketplace listing (better cost story). Add a small note: "Quality-sensitive workloads may prefer fp16" and link to evals. For orchestrator config, example snippet: `adapter: gateflow-v1
model_variant: int8
batching: auto`
Sam: +1 to int8 default. I'll include both int8 and fp16 latency/cost rows in the table. Also will add KV-cache warmup notes we saw that impact p95.
Jordan: I'll prep marketing outline and ask legal for the quote template. Do we have partner-approved logos?
Maya: GateFlow sent logos; uploading to drive now. Also tagging HW partners — they want a short line about LambdaEdge GPU compatibility. Can someone confirm we tested 24GB mode?
Raj: We ran smoke on 24GB mode on L40 last week, passed perf baseline (within 10% p95). I'll include the exact numbers.
AnnounceBot: :spiral_calendar: Reminder — partnership announcement checklist due in 48 hours. Please update `partners/launch-checklist` with final items.
Erin: For the adapter README, I'll add a minimal quickstart: 1) install `redwood-orch` 2) `redwood connect --adapter gateflow --model int8` 3) example request with streaming and tool-calls.
Maya: Action items now: Raj -> perf CSV + numbers (today EOD). Sam -> perf table & KV notes. Erin -> adapter README + example config. Jordan -> marketing outline + embargo date. Everyone -> add comments to PR. Meeting tomorrow 10am PT to sign off.
Sam: ack. I'll run extra runs for 1024 ctx if partner asks.
Raj: one more thing — partner asks for a small compatibility blurb for SI docs about routing fallbacks (if dedicated pool empty). Do we want to publish that?
Maya: Yes, draft a short statement: "Requests will fallback to compatible model variants and regions under capacity constraints" — have infra review.
Jordan: I'll propose webinar dates in thread after I confirm with partners.
Maya: Thanks all. See you at 10am.
Raj: 👍
Erin: :thumbsup:
Jordan: ✅
